Lara: kicking off RC v2.0.0 from `release/2.0` commit `d4c3b2a`. Target promo window 16:00 PT. Need quick canary smoke.
Tim: ack, running smoke and core flows. Will standby for promo.
test-bot: CI: build rc-v2.0.0 artifact sha: b7a6c5d. Unit tests: 980 passed, 2 flaky reruns. Integration: ok.
Ravi: saw minor auth flake in ci, reran and passed. Logging ticket later.
Lara: pin artifact rc-v2.0.0 -> b7a6c5d. Promote to staging now, 4% canary. Rollout surge cap 10%.
deploybot: Promotion to staging requested: `/deploy promote --artifact b7a6c5d --to staging --tag rc-v2.0.0`
deploybot: Staging deploy OK. Canary 4% active. Instances healthy.
Tim: telemetry: p95 stable, p99 spike +110ms during warmup but no errors. Likely KV cold starts.
Ravi: enabling temporary prewarm flag: `KV_WARMUP=1` for rollout.
Lara: rollback criteria: errors >0.4% sustained 4m OR p99 +200ms sustained 4m OR 5xx spike. Rollback command: `/deploy rollback --to-artifact 1.9.7-ff1122 --reason "v2.0.0 regression"` Emergency route cut: `/infra route shift --service web --to stable-1.9.7 --immediate`
test-bot: Regression smoke on staging: PASS. All critical flows OK.
Lara: opening prod promo window at 16:00 PT. Confirm availability?
Tim: I9m available.
Ravi: available, will monitor logs and trace.
deploybot: Scheduled promo: 16:00 PT. Command: `/deploy promote --artifact b7a6c5d --to prod --tag rc-v2.0.0`
deploybot: Prod promotion requested by Lara: `/deploy promote --artifact b7a6c5d --to prod --tag rc-v2.0.0`
deploybot: Rolling deploy in progress across 3 regions, max surge 10%.
deploybot: Promotion succeeded: all regions healthy, rollout complete.
Tim: quick readout: p50/p95 unchanged, p99 back to baseline. No error-rate increase.
Ravi: post-deploy sanity checks passed 1. Embedding smoke OK, auth flows OK.
Lara: release notes updated in docs/releases/v2.0.0.md. Closing thread 1. If any regression, follow rollback steps above and ping #eng-oncall.
